# rules

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/prometheus/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/prometheus/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

Prometheus-owned alerting and recording rules as `rules.list` returns them, one record per rule.

`connectors_prometheus.rules` is one of connectors_prometheus's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `AlertState`

`connectors_prometheus.rules.AlertState` is one of `inactive`, `pending` and `firing`.

### `Rule`

`connectors_prometheus.rules.Rule` is a record of 12 fields:

- `group` — `String`
- `group_interval_ms` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `name` — `String`
- `kind` — `connectors_prometheus.rules.RuleKind`
- `query` — `String`
- `labels` — `Map<String, String>`
- `annotations` — `Map<String, String>`
- `health` — `connectors_prometheus.rules.RuleHealth`
- `last_error` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `state` — `Optional<connectors_prometheus.rules.AlertState>`, which may be absent
- `duration_ms` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `active_alerts` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(group.count >= 1 and group.count <= 1024)`, `(name.count >= 1 and name.count <= 1024)`, `(query.count >= 1 and query.count <= 16384)`, `(last_error.count >= 1 and last_error.count <= 256)`, `active_alerts >= 0`, `duration_ms >= 0`, `group_interval_ms >= 0` and `((kind == alerting and defined(state) and defined(active_alerts)) or (kind == recording and not (defined(state)) and not (defined(duration_ms)) and not (defined(active_alerts))))`.

### `RuleHealth`

`connectors_prometheus.rules.RuleHealth` is one of `ok`, `err` and `unknown`.

### `RuleKind`

`connectors_prometheus.rules.RuleKind` is one of `alerting` and `recording`.

### `RulesSelection`

`connectors_prometheus.rules.RulesSelection` is a record of one field:

- `kind` — `Optional<connectors_prometheus.rules.RuleKind>`, which may be absent

Two of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_prometheus.rules.Rule` and `connectors_prometheus.rules.RulesSelection`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
